items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Stacked rows that open in place, so a long page of answers stays short until someone asks for one.

items.name: action-bar
items.title: Action Bar
items.description: Appears when items are selected, with the count, the actions and a way to clear, floating over the page, docked to its edge or sitting in the flow.

items.name: agent-avatar
items.title: Agent Avatar
items.description: A deterministic SVG face for an agent: the same seed always draws the same overlapping blobs, in theme colours.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: An in-page message with a title, description, action and dismiss, in neutral, success, warning and error tones and four layouts.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A question that has to be answered before anything else, with focus on the safe answer, a typed confirmation for the worst cases and a bottom sheet on phones.

items.name: angle-slider
items.title: Angle Slider
items.description: A dial for rotation and other circular values: drags one to one under pointer capture, steps by keyboard, wraps past 360, with a ring, a marked compass, a small knob and a 270 degree gauge.

items.name: animated-beam
items.title: Animated Beam
items.description: A line of light running between two real elements, measured so it follows every reflow: straight, bowed, stepped like a circuit or many sources into one hub.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App Shell
items.description: The frame of an app: sidebar, top bar, list and detail, or one reading column, with a skip link and landmarks, following its own width rather than the viewport.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Holds the space for media before it arrives, so the page does not jump, with a mat, an overlaid caption or an empty slot.

items.name: aurora-background
items.title: Aurora Background
items.description: Light with height and direction: curtains from the top, a glow from the bottom edge, a ring behind the centre or one diagonal ribbon, with an optional slow drift.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A face or initials that identifies a person at a glance, alone or as an overlapping group with a +N.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Small status chip in five variants; the warm mise variant is reserved for the one item that must stand out.

items.name: beam-border
items.title: Beam Border
items.description: One beam of light travelling the border of the surface the model is working on, so the eye knows where to wait.

items.name: beams-background
items.title: Beams Background
items.description: Straight lines of light behind a section: a fan, lights on a grid, one slow band or soft shafts, quiet enough to keep the sentence on top first.

items.name: before-after
items.title: Before After
items.description: Two versions of one thing, compared with a divider you drag or a lens that follows the pointer. A real slider, keyboard included.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A trail from the root to the current page, with a nav landmark, a current marker and a middle that collapses into a menu.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Press target that answers on pointer-down: a 3% dip in 100 ms, so the click feels acknowledged.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Related actions joined under one border, across or down, including a main action with a menu of its alternatives.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A full-size calendar for showing what is on: month grid with labels, a seven day strip, a grouped agenda or a whole year, with a keyboard grid and any locale.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Bordered surface with header, content and footer slots that reads as one region before anyone reads the text.

items.name: card-deck
items.title: Card Deck
items.description: A one-at-a-time deck for an argument told in order: a swipeable strip, a pile, story tap zones or titles beside the slide, with an optional rewind.

items.name: card-stack
items.title: Card Stack
items.description: A pile of things with no order: a scattered heap to drag through, a fan that spreads, a swipe to decide on each or notification rows that open into a list.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Slides on native scroll snapping with no library: swipe, buttons and arrow keys, as a single slide, visible neighbours, a stacked deck or a thumbnail strip.

items.name: cascader
items.title: Cascader
items.description: Pick from nested options: columns on wide screens, one level at a time on phones, with search, full keyboard, lazy children and the path shown in the trigger.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Bar, line, area and donut charts from one data shape, hand-drawn in SVG with nice-number axes, keyboard points and a real data table for assistive tech.

items.name: chat-assistant
items.title: Chat Assistant
items.description: An AI chat that shows the model working, as a full screen, a panel docked beside the work, or a launcher that opens a small window.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Square toggle that fills and draws its check within 150 ms of the press, and announces the change through aria-checked.

items.name: click-spark
items.title: Click Spark
items.description: A wrapper that answers a press with a small burst from that point: lines, falling bits, one soft ring or a little confetti, on one canvas that only draws while something is alive.

items.name: clipboard
items.title: Clipboard
items.description: One-press copy with a clear result: a lone icon, a code line, a read-only field or a labelled block, and a safe way out when the browser refuses.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: Readable code without a highlighting library: a small tokenizer for ts, json and bash, line numbers, marked lines, wrap, copy, file tabs and diffs.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: One disclosure: a label that opens the detail under it, for the one thing most readers can skip.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: A saturation square, hue and opacity sliders, typed hex and presets, in a popover, inline, as presets only, or as a compact field, with a thumb that never lags behind the hand.

items.name: color-swatch
items.title: Color Swatch
items.description: Shows a colour with its name and value, alone or as a palette, with a label that stays readable on any fill and a checker under transparency.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A searchable select for long lists, single or multiple, with people rows, section headers, chips and loading built in.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A command palette with its own fuzzy search: groups, shortcuts, recent items, an empty state, full combobox and listbox semantics and a Mod+K helper.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: The menu that opens where you press: right-click, long press or the Menu key, with sub menus, check and radio items and shortcuts.

items.name: count-up
items.title: Count Up
items.description: A number that counts to its value without moving what sits beside it, formatted by Intl, with rolling digits, tiles or a meter line.

items.name: cta-section
items.title: CTA Section
items.description: One clear thing to do, in three decisions: a plate that ends the page, text beside a piece of the product, or a slim row inside a long page.

items.name: dashboard-overview
items.title: Dashboard Overview
items.description: A product dashboard in three decisions: one number first, one large chart first, or the work list first with the numbers as one line.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Hand it rows and columns and get sorting, a filter box, selection, column visibility, pages, loading rows and bulk actions, with rows that turn into cards in a narrow container.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A calendar with no date library: single days or ranges, limits, a full keyboard grid and any locale, as a popover, inline, a typed field or two months with a band.

items.name: decision-cards
items.title: Decision Cards
items.description: A record of decisions: the question, what was chosen, what lost and why, for case studies, design docs and postmortems.

items.name: decrypt-text
items.title: Decrypt Text
items.description: Text that starts unreadable and is decoded in place, on first view or behind a real button, with the sentence out of the accessibility tree until it opens.

items.name: description-list
items.title: Description List
items.description: Labels and values on a real dl, as ruled rows, two columns, single lines or tiles, with a slot for a copy button and long values that wrap.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal surface that dims everything else and holds focus until the user answers one question.

items.name: dock
items.title: Dock
items.description: A row of icon buttons that swell near the pointer and rise without moving the page: a glass bar, bare tiles, a side rail or words under every icon.

items.name: docs-layout
items.title: Docs Layout
items.description: A documentation screen from a list of pages: nav, page and table of contents, one column for a short guide, or text beside its code. Collapses on phones.

items.name: dot-background
items.title: Dot Background
items.description: Small marks behind your content: an even dot field, a fading one, plus marks or a halftone growing toward one corner, with an optional colour around the pointer.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A panel that slides in from an edge for a side task, so the page you came from stays where you left it.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Compact menu of actions that opens from a button and closes on choice, with arrow-key navigation and a destructive variant.

items.name: editable
items.title: Editable
items.description: Text that turns into a field in place without moving the page: Enter commits, Escape reverts, leaving commits or reverts by prop, with validation and optional buttons.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: What a list or a search shows when it has nothing: an icon, a plain reason and the next step, centred, in a dashed slot, on a card or in one row.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: A first screen that gives people somewhere to start: worked examples, the first three things to do, or a ghost of the filled screen with sample data.

items.name: error-page
items.title: Error Page
items.description: A 404, 500 or offline screen with honest wording and a way out that can work: one sentence, beside places that still work, or a plain readout for developer tools.

items.name: faq-section
items.title: FAQ Section
items.description: Answers before someone has to ask: a short list on one plate, a longer list beside a heading that stays in view, or a filter box with an empty state.

items.name: feature-bento
items.title: Feature Bento
items.description: A features section in three forms: an asymmetric grid of mixed cell sizes, alternating picture and text rows, or a list of features driving one large panel.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Gives any control a label, description, error and required mark, and wires the ids and aria attributes so nobody has to remember them.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File Upload
items.description: A real drop zone and file input with type, size and count limits, clear errors and a progress list. It never touches the network: you upload and pass the state back.

items.name: filter-chips
items.title: Filter Chips
items.description: Filters a list you already have: chips with result counts, an all chip, a clear button, dead ends disabled and the result count announced.

items.name: floating-nav
items.title: Floating Nav
items.description: Navigation that floats over the page: a pill with a sliding highlight, a capsule that opens into a panel, a bar that shrinks on scroll or a bottom tab bar.

items.name: floating-panel
items.title: Floating Panel
items.description: A movable window that stays on screen: drag with pointer capture, resize, minimise, close and move by keyboard, as a titled panel, tight chrome, a side dock or a tool palette.

items.name: flow
items.title: Flow
items.description: A process drawn from data with no diagram library: a step-by-step walkthrough, boxes and arrows that wrap, a numbered rail or one inline line.

items.name: glass-core
items.title: Glass Core
items.description: A glass object for the centre of a hero, with no WebGL: a shaded knot on a small canvas, a CSS sphere or frosted panes. Respects reduced motion and reduced transparency.

items.name: glitch-text
items.title: Glitch Text
items.description: A short stepped burst that ends in clean text: colour fringes, shifting bands, dropped letters or a jumping line, and it never loops.

items.name: globe
items.title: Globe
items.description: A turning dotted earth on one canvas with no 3D library: land dots, a wire ball, a shaded disc or routes with a light along them, plus markers and drag to spin.

items.name: gooey-morph
items.title: Gooey Morph
items.description: Status dots that merge into one body and split apart again like a liquid, so the eye tracks one thing changing.

items.name: gradient-text
items.title: Gradient Text
items.description: A headline painted with a gradient from theme tokens, legible in every palette, with solid fallbacks for high contrast and forced colours.

items.name: grid-background
items.title: Grid Background
items.description: Hairlines behind your content: an even grid, a fading one, a floor receding to a horizon or a few filled cells, with an optional brightening around the pointer.

items.name: highlighter-text
items.title: Highlighter Text
items.description: A mark drawn over text that is already readable, line by line, as a marker band, an underline or a hand-drawn stroke or outline.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A preview that appears over a link when the pointer rests on it, laid out for free content, a person, a page or a number.

items.name: hover-preview
items.title: Hover Preview
items.description: A preview that follows the pointer over a list of links. Off on touch, reachable by keyboard, and never the only way to anything.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: Icon Button
items.description: A glyph-only button that cannot be shipped without a name, with four surfaces, a pending state that keeps focus and a 40 px hit area on touch.

items.name: image-cropper
items.title: Image Cropper
items.description: Drag, pinch or wheel to frame a picture, with keyboard nudges and an aspect lock, returning a crop rectangle that can never leave the image.

items.name: image-trail
items.title: Image Trail
items.description: Pictures appear along the pointer's path and fade in order, pile up, fan out or slide past, with a still arrangement on touch so the box is never blank.

items.name: indicator
items.title: Indicator
items.description: A small count, dot, ring or word pinned to the corner of what it describes, gone at zero and spelled out for screen readers.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Single-line text field, 36 px tall to match Button, that moves the invalid state onto its border and ring.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: One field with text, icons, buttons or a select attached to it, sharing a single border and focus ring, in four layouts.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: One-time code entry drawn as boxes but built on one real input, so SMS autofill, paste, backspace and screen readers all work.

items.name: intelligence-glow
items.title: Intelligence Glow
items.description: A slow light around the screen edge while the assistant listens or thinks, visible from anywhere on the page.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keyboard keys as hairline caps, physical keys, tight chips or plain text, with chords, a platform-aware modifier and a cap that dips on the real key.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Caption bound to a control: clicking it focuses the field, and it dims when the field is disabled.

items.name: landing-hero
items.title: Landing Hero
items.description: A marketing hero with one message and two actions, in four layouts: beside a live preview, over a wide product plate, beside two overlapped fragments, or type alone.

items.name: lens
items.title: Lens
items.description: A magnifier over any content: a round lens, a lifted loupe, a zoomed panel beside it or a full-width band, with a second copy that focus and assistive tech never reach.

items.name: liquid-metal
items.title: Liquid Metal
items.description: A WebGL metal surface behind a button or chip, with reflections that drift so the control reads as a real, premium material.

items.name: listbox
items.title: Listbox
items.description: A list you choose from, always open: single or multiple, type-ahead, Home and End, groups and disabled options, written to the full ARIA pattern.

items.name: loading-overlay
items.title: Loading Overlay
items.description: Covers its parent while work runs, and only its parent. Waits before showing so fast answers never flash, and keeps layout and focus in place.

items.name: login-form
items.title: Login Form
items.description: A login with labels that stay visible and inline errors, in three forms: beside a calm brand panel with a password you can reveal, one card on a grey ground, or email only with a check-your-inbox screen.

items.name: logo-wall
items.title: Logo Wall
items.description: Logos you have permission to show, in three decisions: a quiet row, a plate for each, or a marquee for more than fit. Includes dashed placeholders to build with until you have them.

items.name: magnet
items.title: Magnet
items.description: A wrapper that pulls any child toward the pointer from past its own bounds: the whole element, inner layers, a row by distance, or a soft ring that trails.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: An endless CSS-driven row that stops when someone reaches for it, and turns into a still, scrollable row for people who turned motion off.

items.name: mask-input
items.title: Mask Input
items.description: Formats dates, phone numbers, cards and your own patterns as you type. The caret stays put in the middle and on paste, and deleting across a dash works.

items.name: materialize
items.title: Materialize
items.description: A surface that arrives like a material coming into focus: slightly smaller, softer, from its anchor, and leaves the same way.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: The row of menus desktop tools are built on, with sub menus, check and radio items, shortcuts and full arrow key movement across the bar.

items.name: mesh-background
items.title: Mesh Background
items.description: Large soft colour from the accent and its neighbours, barely tinted to vivid, from one corner or split on a diagonal, with an optional slow drift.

items.name: meteors-background
items.title: Meteors Background
items.description: Short streaks crossing a section: thin meteors, faint rain, slow comets or a twinkling sky, placed from a seed and moved with transforms only.

items.name: metro-map
items.title: Metro Map
items.description: Lines and stations drawn from data, for a process or a path with branches: arrow keys between stations, and it scrolls inside itself when narrow.

items.name: motion
items.title: Motion presets
items.description: Critically damped and momentum springs, Apple's momentum projection and rubber-banding, shared by every moving Mise UI component.

items.name: motion-reveal
items.title: Motion Reveal
items.description: One wrapper that lets its content arrive when it comes into view, once, as a block or child by child. People who turned motion off see it at once.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Site navigation with panels on Radix: a plain bar, a mega panel of groups, a sliding pill or a sliding underline, and a panel that morphs between triggers.

items.name: noise-background
items.title: Noise Background
items.description: Film grain drawn from an inline SVG with no image files: fine grain, warm paper, grain over a soft accent wash, or sparse flecks.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number Input
items.description: A field for amounts that clamps to its range, repeats while a button is held, reads formatted text back, and comes as chevrons, split, pill or one big number.

items.name: onboarding-checklist
items.title: Onboarding Checklist
items.description: First-run setup with a true progress count: a list as its own screen, a slim row above the page, or welcome steps one at a time in a dialog.

items.name: orbiting-circles
items.title: Orbiting Circles
items.description: Small things travelling around a centre: one orbit, several at different speeds, a tilted ellipse that passes behind or an arch at the foot of a hero. Focus and pointing stop it.

items.name: page-wipe
items.title: Page Wipe
items.description: Full-page wipes on the View Transitions API: an accent curtain, a slanted sweep or an iris from the click. Reduced motion falls back to a fade.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Moves through a long list in steady chunks, with the window of pages always the same width so controls never shift.

items.name: panel-stack
items.title: Panel Stack
items.description: A story told one panel at a time with a page count and a progress line: in the page, with the next panel peeking, or sliding over the whole screen.

items.name: particles-background
items.title: Particles Background
items.description: Points on one canvas behind a section: floating, joined by faint lines, rising, or an even field with a clearing that follows the pointer.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: A password field with a reveal button and a caps lock hint, plus a strength meter, a live checklist or a meter on the field edge.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Small floating panel anchored to the control that opened it, for a form or detail that does not need a full dialog.

items.name: post-row
items.title: Post Row
items.description: One writing entry as a single link: a title, a date that stays on its calendar day and quiet tags, for blogs, changelogs and archives.

items.name: pricing-table
items.title: Pricing Table
items.description: Pricing with an honest yearly anchor, in three forms: three plans with one raised, a side-by-side feature matrix with a sticky plan header, or one plan priced by the seat.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Shows how far a task has come, as a bar, a hairline, discrete steps or a labelled percent, and admits it when nobody knows yet.

items.name: progress-circular
items.title: Progress Circular
items.description: Progress in a small square: a ring, a hairline, a 270 degree gauge or discrete cells, with the value in the middle and an honest state when nobody knows.

items.name: qr-code
items.title: QR Code
items.description: A QR code encoder written from scratch and drawn as crisp SVG with a quiet zone, in square, dotted, framed and logo forms, always dark on light so it scans.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: One choice from a short list with every option in view, as dots, selectable cards, joined buttons or rows, with arrow keys built in.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: A score picked with a click or the arrow keys, as stars, hearts, a joined number scale or a row of segments, with half steps and a read-only form.

items.name: reasoning-steps
items.title: Reasoning Steps
items.description: Collapsed timeline of the model's steps; the header names the current one, the body shows them all.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Two panes with a draggable divider, horizontal or vertical, with limits that stretch, a keyboard-operable separator and a double-click reset.

items.name: reveal-image
items.title: Reveal Image
items.description: An image that arrives as it is generated: blur to sharp, coarse mosaic to fine, or a left-to-right wipe, driven by a progress value.

items.name: ring-gallery
items.title: Ring Gallery
items.description: A small set of items on a CSS 3D ring you spin by drag or keyboard, with no WebGL. Reduced motion gets a plain list.

items.name: ripple-background
items.title: Ripple Background
items.description: Rings spreading behind a section: still lines, a slow pulse, a turning sonar sweep or several sources, plus a ring from where someone pressed.

items.name: role-map
items.title: Role Map
items.description: Who did what on a project: panels, quiet rows or a table of people against areas, with one person in the accent.

items.name: roll-text
items.title: Roll Text
items.description: A label that rolls to a fresh copy of itself on hover or when its value changes, while assistive tech hears it once.

items.name: rotating-text
items.title: Rotating Text
items.description: One word in a sentence that takes turns with others, with a slot that springs to each new width and stops whenever someone is reading.

items.name: scramble-text
items.title: Scramble Text
items.description: Noise that settles into the real sentence, from a small seeded engine, with every letter holding its final width so nothing on the page moves.

items.name: screen-frame
items.title: Screen Frame
items.description: A window, a phone or a plain hairline around a screenshot or live interface, with the real address in the bar and no decorative traffic lights.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A scroller with a styled bar that matches the theme, as a hover bar, a thin overlay, edge shadows or a snapping row.

items.name: scroll-shadow
items.title: Scroll Shadow
items.description: A wrapper for any scrolling box that shows edge shadows, fades or hairlines from the real scroll position, so people can see there is more.

items.name: scrub-text
items.title: Scrub Text
items.description: A paragraph that arrives word by word as you scroll, so the pace of reading stays in the reader's hand. People who turned motion off get the finished text.

items.name: search-field
items.title: Search Field
items.description: A search box with a leading icon, clear button, loading state, debounced onSearch and a Mod K hint. Escape clears it.

items.name: section-index
items.title: Section Index
items.description: A numbered map of the chapters in a long read that fills as you go, as a rail, a sticky strip or a one-line counter.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: A short set of mutually exclusive views, always one on, as a thumb in a track, chips, an underline or square icons.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Dropdown for one choice from a list, with a placeholder, groups, a check on the chosen row and full keyboard support.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A rule between groups of content, as a hairline, a dashed break, a labelled divider or a line that fades at both ends.

items.name: settings-page
items.title: Settings Page
items.description: A settings screen in three decisions: one page with one save bar, one section at a time beside a side nav, or each group as its own plate with its own Save.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Bottom sheet you can grab mid-flight: it tracks the finger 1:1, rubber-bands at the top, and lands where the release velocity was heading.

items.name: shimmer-text
items.title: Shimmer Text
items.description: A band of light passing over a status label, so “Thinking…” reads as in progress without inventing a percentage.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A collapsible column of navigation with nested groups, an active item and badges, toggled with Mod+B, saved through a prop, and a drawer on phones.

items.name: signature-pad
items.title: Signature Pad
items.description: Sign with a finger, pen or mouse in smooth strokes, with undo, SVG and PNG export, and a typed name for anyone using a keyboard.

items.name: signup-steps
items.title: Signup Steps
items.description: A sign-up that asks one question at a time, starts with real progress and never ticks consent for anyone, in a card, beside a rail of what is left, or as one large question per screen.

items.name: site-footer
items.title: Site Footer
items.description: The end of every page, in three decisions: a full map of the site, one quiet line, or a newsletter field above the links.

items.name: site-header
items.title: Site Header
items.description: A marketing site's top navigation with a skip link and a drawer on phones: a plain row of links, panels of grouped links, or pieces floating over the page.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Pulsing placeholder shaped like the content that is loading, so the wait feels shorter than a spinner.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Picks a value or a range by feel, as a thin line, a thick volume track, labelled steps or a value bubble, with full keyboard control.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Says work is running when nobody knows how long it will take: a ring, three dots, eight bars or an orbit, with a pulse instead of movement for people who turned motion off.

items.name: split-text
items.title: Split Text
items.description: A headline that arrives letter by letter or word by word, with the real sentence kept for assistive tech and a table of presets to extend.

items.name: spoiler
items.title: Spoiler
items.description: Hides text or a block until someone presses to see it, so the reader chooses the moment. Screen readers do not get ahead of everyone else.

items.name: spotlight
items.title: Spotlight
items.description: A surface that catches a soft light under the pointer, on its face, on its edge or by uncovering a hidden layer. Off on touch.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: One number with its label, change and a small trend line. Colour only appears once you have said which direction is good.

items.name: stat-line
items.title: Stat Line
items.description: One line of several figures, before and after included: equal columns, a running sentence or one big number above the rest.

items.name: station-dialog
items.title: Station Dialog
items.description: A detail dialog that opens from a point on a map or list, can grow out of it, and sends focus back to it on close.

items.name: stats-section
items.title: Stats Section
items.description: Numbers that make a claim believable, in three decisions: several of equal weight, one to remember above the rest, or each beside what it counts.

items.name: status
items.title: Status
items.description: A state word with a mark that means something: online, away, busy, offline, error or your own, each with its own shape as well as its own hue.

items.name: steps
items.title: Steps
items.description: Shows where someone is in a process, across a line, down a column, as a bar with a count or as numbered rows, with done, current, upcoming and error states.

items.name: story-section
items.title: Story Section
items.description: A numbered section of a long read, with the number, heading and text set three ways and a note for what is still to be written.

items.name: streaming-text
items.title: Streaming Text
items.description: Reveals arriving text character by character at reading speed, with a caret that marks where the next word lands.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Sliding on/off control whose thumb travels 16 px in 150 ms, mirroring the physical toggle it imitates.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Real table markup with sortable headers, a sticky head, selection state, an empty row and right-aligned figures, in plain, striped, card or compact, scrolling inside itself when narrow.

items.name: table-of-contents
items.title: Table of Contents
items.description: Lists the sections of a page, from data or read from the headings, follows the one being read and jumps to any of them with motion that respects reduced motion.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Segmented control that swaps one panel for another in place, so related views share a single spot on the screen.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: A short label that can also be pressed or removed: soft tint, outline, solid or a status dot, with status tones that never borrow the accent.

items.name: tags-input
items.title: Tags Input
items.description: A field for many short values: add with Enter or comma, paste a whole list, walk tags with the arrows, with limits, validation and suggestions.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text field that starts at 64 px and grows with its content, so the answer is never hidden behind a scrollbar.

items.name: theme
items.title: Mise theme
items.description: Warm amber on cool neutrals. Friendly and alive. Complete tokens, motion included.

theme.font-display: "Geist Variable", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", system-ui, sans-serif

items.name: theme-cobalt
items.title: Cobalt theme
items.description: Saturated blue. Trustworthy, for finance and B2B. Complete tokens, motion included.

theme.font-display: "Geist Variable", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", system-ui, sans-serif

items.name: theme-ember
items.title: Ember theme
items.description: Hot rose. Bold, for consumer and creative products. Complete tokens, motion included.

theme.font-display: "Geist Variable", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", system-ui, sans-serif

items.name: theme-forest
items.title: Forest theme
items.description: Deep green. Calm, for health, money and climate. Complete tokens, motion included.

theme.font-display: "Geist Variable", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", system-ui, sans-serif

items.name: theme-ink
items.title: Ink theme
items.description: No colour at all. Serious, for tools and documents. Complete tokens, motion included.

theme.font-display: "Geist Variable", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", system-ui, sans-serif

items.name: thinking-indicator
items.title: Thinking Indicator
items.description: Three breathing dots and a live label that tell the user the model is working, and on what.

items.name: thinking-orb
items.title: Thinking Orb
items.description: A breathing sphere whose motion says idle, listening, thinking or speaking without a word of text.

items.name: tilted-card
items.title: Tilted Card
items.description: A showcase card with strong tilt and depth for a picture or a pass: a floating caption, a foil sheen, parts on separate planes or a notched ticket, with text sharp at rest.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Events in order with time, title, detail and a status that keeps its meaning under any accent, down a rail, on two sides, as one-liners or across a row.

items.name: timer
items.title: Timer
items.description: Counts down to a moment or up from one, with pause and resume. It reads the clock instead of adding ticks, so a sleeping tab cannot make it wrong.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A brief message about something that just happened, which waits while you read it and leaves without being asked.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays pressed: quiet fill, darkening border, filter chip with a check, or a square icon in the accent.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A row of buttons that stay pressed, one at a time or several at once: quiet fill, joined outline, wrapping chips or square icons.

items.name: tool-call-card
items.title: Tool Call Card
items.description: Collapsible record of one tool call: name, status, duration, and the exact input and output on demand.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: A row of tools that is one tab stop: arrow keys rove inside it, with groups, separators, links and toggles, and it wraps or scrolls instead of breaking the layout.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: One-line hint that appears on hover or focus with no delay and leaves with the pointer, for detail that does not deserve screen space.

items.name: tour
items.title: Tour
items.description: A step-by-step product tour with a spotlight cut-out, anchored to a selector or a ref. It manages focus, scrolls targets into view, follows them on resize and skips the ones that are missing.

items.name: tree-view
items.title: Tree View
items.description: A nested list written to the full ARIA tree pattern: arrow keys, type-ahead, single or multiple selection and lazy children, with guide lines, dense rows or a card per branch.

items.name: typewriter-text
items.title: Typewriter Text
items.description: A staged line that types itself with a human rhythm, the whole text laid out from the start so lines never reflow, and a caret that goes away when it is done.

items.name: use-view-transition
items.title: useViewTransition
items.description: Five named page-transition presets on the View Transitions API, with a reduced-motion cross-fade and a plain fallback.

items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: cn() class merger.

items.name: verification-code
items.title: Verification Code
items.description: A one-time code screen with a resend countdown, wrong-code and success states, in wording that never reveals whether an address exists: one card, beside what to look for in the inbox, or a row inside your own form.

items.name: view-counter
items.title: View Counter
items.description: A view count from a fetcher you pass, with loading and failure states and no network code of its own.

items.name: voice-glow
items.title: Voice Glow
items.description: A round glow that swells with the microphone level, so the user sees the assistant is listening and how loudly it hears them.

items.name: voice-wave
items.title: Voice Wave
items.description: Bars that rise with the microphone level so the user can see they are being heard, and see when they are not.
